headline: Photosynthesis converts sunlight into food—leaves are the foundation of almost all life on Earth
universal_truth: Everything depends on something; understanding foundational processes reveals what truly matters
fun_facts: Leaves produce all the oxygen in our atmosphere—every breath you take comes from photosynthesis
Photosynthesis converts about 100 billion tons of carbon into plant matter each year
A single tree can produce enough oxygen for two people for a year
discussion_questions: What's the 'photosynthesis' in your life—the foundational process everything depends on?
What upstream inputs make all your outputs possible?
Where does your 'energy' really come from?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Every hamburger, every apple, every chicken wing—all of it traces back to a leaf catching sunlight. Photosynthesis is the original manufacturing: turning light into food, supporting virtually all life on Earth. Leaves feed the world.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Photosynthesis seems like just a plant thing—but it's the foundation of almost all life. What does this teach us about systems?

options.text: Everything depends on foundational processes—complex systems rest on simpler ones; understanding the base level reveals what truly matters and what's at risk
options.response: Yes. Remove photosynthesis and almost everything dies. The foundation matters most. Complex achievements rest on simpler essentials. Know your dependencies.

options.text: Plants just happen to need light
options.response: They need it, and so does everything that eats them—or eats things that eat them...

q1.title: Universal Dependency
q1.script: Herbivores eat plants. Carnivores eat herbivores. Decomposers break down both. Everything traces back to sunlight captured by leaves. One process, one foundation, endless variety.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Universal Dependency"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Energy Flow
q2.script: Photosynthesis is the entry point for energy into the living world. Without it, no food chains, no ecosystems, no you. Understanding energy flow reveals what actually matters.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Personal Foundations
q3.script: What's your photosynthesis—the foundational process that everything else depends on? Health? Income? Key relationship? Core skill? Protect your foundations; everything else is downstream.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Everything depends on something. Understanding foundational processes reveals what truly matters. Protect your foundations.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 274—welcome to October! Tomorrow, we'll explore energy from falling water. Until then, identify what foundational process your life depends on.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Foundation Mapping - What Does Everything Depend On?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify foundational processes in your life
growTrack.activity: What's the 'photosynthesis' in your life—the thing everything else depends on? Health? Primary income source? Key relationship? If that fails, what else collapses? Protect and strengthen your foundations.
